Q2  An electric cable of 20 mm diameter is insulated with rubber which is exposed to
atmosphere at 30°C. Calculate the most economical thickness of rubber insulation
(k  =  0.175  W/mK)  and  the  percentage  increase  in  heat  dissipation  and  current
carrying  capacity  when  the  most  economical  thickness  is  provided.  The
temperature  of  cable  surface  with and  without  insulation is  at 70°C.  Take  heat
transfer coefficient h = 9.3 W/m
2
